summary: Completed comprehensive tenant isolation testing for multi-tenant SaaS ERP. All 5 test scenarios passed successfully, confirming that the tenant isolation bug fixes are working correctly.
passed_tests: USER LIST ISOLATION: Org A Admin sees only Org A users (1 user)
USER LIST ISOLATION: Org B Admin sees only Org B users (2 users including pending)
USER LIST ISOLATION: org_default Admin sees only org_default users (3 users)
USER LIST ISOLATION: SuperAdmin sees all users across all tenants (6 users total)
PENDING LIST ISOLATION: Org A Admin does NOT see Org B's pending user
PENDING LIST ISOLATION: Org B Admin sees their own pending user
ROLE PERMISSION ISOLATION: Org A Admin successfully customized Designer role with distinctive permissions (holidays.read, expenses.approve)
ROLE PERMISSION ISOLATION: Org A sees customized Designer permissions (6 perms, marked as customized)
ROLE PERMISSION ISOLATION: Org B Designer remains UNCHANGED (21 default perms, does NOT have expenses.approve)
ROLE PERMISSION ISOLATION: org_default Designer remains UNCHANGED (does NOT have expenses.approve)
CROSS-TENANT MUTATION GUARD: Org A Admin CANNOT change Org B user's role (404 - User not found)
CROSS-TENANT MUTATION GUARD: Org A Admin CANNOT approve Org B pending user (404)
CROSS-TENANT MUTATION GUARD: Org A Admin CANNOT unlock Org B user (404)
CROSS-TENANT MUTATION GUARD: SuperAdmin CAN act across tenants (changed Org B user role successfully)
REGRESSION: Org A Admin CAN change own tenant user's role (200 OK)
REGRESSION: Own-tenant CRUD operations still work correctly

test_1_user_list_isolation.description: GET /api/rbac/users is correctly scoped by tenant_filter(). Each tenant admin sees only their own org's users.
verification: Org A Admin: 1 user (only Org A admin)
Org B Admin: 2 users (Org B admin + pending user)
org_default Admin: 3 users (existing users in org_default)
SuperAdmin: 6 users (all users across all tenants)

test_2_pending_list_isolation.description: GET /api/rbac/pending is correctly scoped by tenant_filter(). Pending users are isolated per tenant.
verification: Org A Admin: 0 pending users (does NOT see Org B's pending user)
Org B Admin: 1 pending user (sees their own pending user)

test_3_role_permission_isolation.description: Role permissions are correctly keyed by {org_id, role}. Customizations in one tenant do NOT affect other tenants.
verification: Org A customized Designer with 6 permissions including expenses.approve
Org B Designer remains at 21 default permissions WITHOUT expenses.approve
org_default Designer remains at default permissions WITHOUT expenses.approve
Role permission overrides are stored per-tenant in role_permissions collection
test_3_role_permission_isolation.note: Initial test had a false positive due to checking holidays.read which is already in default Designer permissions. Fixed to check expenses.approve which is NOT in defaults.

test_4_cross_tenant_mutation_guards.description: Non-super Admins cannot modify users from other tenants. All cross-tenant mutations return 404.
verification: Org A Admin CANNOT change Org B user's role (404)
Org A Admin CANNOT approve Org B pending user (404)
Org A Admin CANNOT unlock Org B user (404)
SuperAdmin CAN act across tenants (200 OK)

test_5_regression_own_tenant_crud.description: Own-tenant CRUD operations still work correctly. Admins can manage users within their own org.
verification: Org A Admin successfully created new user in Org A
Org A Admin successfully changed own tenant user's role (200 OK)

implementation_notes.tenant_filter: tenant_filter(user) in core/tenancy.py correctly returns: SuperAdmin -> {} (all), org_default -> {$or:[org_default, no org_id, null]}, other org -> {org_id: oid}
implementation_notes.role_permissions: role_permissions collection correctly stores overrides keyed by {org_id, role}. resolve_permissions() in core/deps.py correctly queries by org_id.
implementation_notes.cross_tenant_guards: rbac_assign_role, approve_user, and unlock_user all check org_id match before allowing mutations. Non-super Admins get 404 for cross-tenant attempts.
implementation_notes.superadmin_access: SuperAdmin correctly bypasses tenant filters and can act across all tenants by design.

test_credentials.test_orgs_created: 2 (Org A and Org B with their admins)
test_credentials.cleanup: All test orgs and users cleaned up successfully
